about: A Navi chip of BN5's whose code moved into BN6's engine (issue #82's C3; docs/multirom/chips-code.md, the Navi chips past nine bits): BN5's CanladEX held paralysed (hold: each game's own status step, the same bits in both) at (5,2), MegaMan with a folder of one DjangoDS D and 29 Cannon A in both games, the DjangoDS dealt first (a Mega chip: a folder of them alone never deals), BN5's chip 280 by BN5's own code and the registry's 526 by the same code moved (BN5's Navi routine 0x13 as BN6's 0x30: his sprites BN5's own, list 3's 0x41, 0x44 and 0x45, copied at numbers of the chips' in BN6's list 3; his attack's objects, the third kind's 0xBC and the fourth kind's 0x7B, 0x7D and 0x84, moved with it), the first Custom screen's chip picked and OK, used at t30: every difference of BN6's play from BN5's fails it (docs/multirom/chips-code.md). MegaMan not dark (BN5's meter at its neutral 500): BN5's dark gate refuses the DS (its record's +0x15 2, 0x08010110) and his chip is the chip of nothing, as BN6's engine does with the Souls installed (KnightSoul held: flags5, souls6; src/emu/soulmood.c's gate).
